description: Generate, score, and shortlist brand names through a guided interview. Use when the user says "name my brand", "help me name", "come up with a name", "naming ideas", "what should I call this", "brand name", "product name", "company name", "rename", "rebrand", or is stuck choosing between names. Self-contained and brand-agnostic: it does not read knowledge/, so it works for naming a brand-new venture, product, service, feature, or rebrand from scratch, before any brand context exists. Runs on Alexandra Watkins' SMILE and SCRATCH tests to generate and filter, Marty Neumeier's 7 criteria to score, and the Lexicon Branding method for sound symbolism and strategy. Asks the user questions before generating. For the positioning the name has to carry, see positioning-doc. For the message architecture built on top of it, see messaging-framework.
